selection: Independent holdout split with fresh start indices 20000+; balanced source bits. GUI-style Rate 3.6, Added Symbols 1, Fs=16 Hz, one-second correlation blocks, two-ray nominal delay/center matched to the frozen Gaussian window width 0.1 Hz. The C/N0 operating points were selected from development before these holdouts; holdout scores are not to be used for tuning or optional stopping.
seed_policy: triad-lowrate-campaign-v1 derives independent key/channel/oscillator/noise/frontend/path roots from split, requested duration, rate, sample-rate numerator, C/N0, global index, bit and domain. Duration/C/N0/index distinguish every G1 cohort; indices are 20000+ and each even-sized cohort balances bits.

targets.score_gate: strict 99% / 1e-4 per-day family; relaxed gate not separately emitted by this score job

sample_size_scope: The 300-path cohorts can support a pointwise 99% lower reception bound only if all 300 are correct and accepted. The 32-path long-duration cohorts are exploratory and cannot establish 99% reliability even at 32/32.
